ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Payment_Model__c, "Partial_Advance_Annual"), OR( ISBLANK(Advance_Through_Month__c), Advance_Through_Month__c < 1, Advance_Through_Month__c > 12 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Advance Through Month must be between 1 and 12 when Payment Model is Partial Advance Annual.
